messages:
matt-cs: Hey team, just got a ping from a customer. They were in the middle of an SSO migration and when they retried auth their trial credits dropped to 0. They reported 401s from the API during the retry window.
jamie-billing: Which account? need acct id + billing customer id.
matt-cs: acct: acme-staging (acct_89G3). Customer timestamps: 2026-03-15T14:05Z -> 14:12Z. They said root token was present and they retried auth twice.
olivia-eng: Can you paste any error logs (from their side or ours)? 401s could be token expiry or a webhook race.
matt-cs: Pasting customer-sent snippet:
```
POST /v1/usage/consume 401 {"error":"invalid_token"}
```
sam-devex: @matt-cs can you check if the usage-processor recorded a final consumption event? Retries sometimes result in duplicated consumption if idempotency keys are missing.
jamie-billing: Searching billing logs for acct_89G3 14:00-14:20Z...
jamie-billing: Found usage_event ue_77x consumed 5000 trial units at 2026-03-15T14:11:20Z, source: api-key-retry. Looks like duplicated consumption from a retry.
olivia-eng: That suggests either the client retried without an idempotency key or our proxy didn't forward the header. We should check the auth proxy and request forwarding codepath.
matt-cs: Customer insists they only hit the endpoint once and retried after seeing the 401. They attached client logs saying the client library auto-retried internally.
sam-devex: For remediation: support can manually reinstate trial credits while engineering investigates. Our policy allows manual grants for platform-induced depletion within 24h of the incident.
jamie-billing: Agreed. I'll prepare a +5000 trial grant and document it as a manual adjustment — need OLIVIA to sign off for engineering follow-up.
olivia-eng: Approve manual grant. I'll create an engineering ticket to verify idempotency-header passthrough and add a test for the SSO reauth flow.
matt-cs: I'll ask the customer for screenshots of their retry and request they share the client’s user-agent and any idempotency-key header if present.
billing-bot: Automated action queued: create_credit_adjustment acct_89G3 +5000 trial_units reason: manual-reinstate-auth-retry.
jamie-billing: Adjustment created: adj_20260315_001. Credits should be visible on the account now.
matt-cs: Customer confirms credits are back. They also shared their client log which shows the client library performed an internal retry (single visible POST from their app but multiple underlying attempts).
sam-devex: Filed infra ticket INF-4523 to add idempotency passthrough at the proxy layer and increase debug logging for usage ingestion.
olivia-eng: We'll prioritize a fix and add an alert that fires if an account consumes >80% of trial credits in a 5-minute window.
matt-cs: I'll close the loop with the customer and add a short playbook entry for CS: how to triage, what evidence to collect, when to grant, and required audit notes.
jamie-billing: Tagging for monthly reconciliation. :white_check_mark: 
matt-cs: Thanks everyone :party:
billing-bot: Note: adj_20260315_001 logged for audit.
